results.title: NCC Bank wins three awards at ICC Emerging Asia Banking Conclave
results.description: NCC Bank has received recognition in three categories at the fourth ICC Emerging Asia Banking Conclave and Awards 2026, organised by the Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC). According to a press release, the bank won the "Best Performance on Risk Management", "Best Bank in MSME Acceleration," and "Best Performance on Asset Quality" awards. The awards were presented on Sunday (26 July) at a ceremony held at Hotel Le Meridien in New Delhi, India, during the conclave.
